title: skill read --if-newer: skip export if cached version is current
desc: wkappbot skill read <id> --if-newer skips re-exporting SKILL.md when cached version matches catalog. Efficient for AI agents to check updates without forcing full re-export.
steps: USAGE: wkappbot skill read <id> --if-newer -- skips write if cached SKILL.md version >= catalog version
BEHAVIOR: cached v >= catalog => [SKILL:EXPORT] up-to-date v{ver}. cached v < catalog => normal export fires
SKILL.MD HEADER: every exported file starts with Refresh line showing --if-newer command and current version so AI always knows how to refresh
CALLER GATING: Claude parent => .claude/ paths only. Codex parent => .codex/ paths only. No cross-writes
WITHOUT FLAG: wkappbot skill read <id> always exports regardless of cache (force-refresh)
CODE: SkillCommand.AiExport.cs IsExportedSkillCurrent() parses Refresh line via regex v(\d+\.\d+). SkillCommand.cs parses --if-newer at skill read handler
author: claude
